text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 棕白小格纹挂脖深V坦基尼，棕色滚边和胸下蝴蝶结细带，同色棕腰边平角泳裤。配饰：金色小圆吊坠项链；金色细手镯。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Create an unoccupied retail product flat lay on pure white, portrait 2:3. Brown and white tiny gingham tankini swim top with halter straps, V neckline, brown piping and narrow underbust bow; matching boyshort swim bottoms with solid brown waistband. Beside the garments, separately spaced: fine gold necklace with small round pendant and a thin gold bangle. Realistic textile and jewelry product photography. Only unworn products, no person or body, no mannequin, no text, no setting, no footwear.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
